newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse Air Brake holder to sell stake.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse Air Brake holder to sell stake.

text.p: Westinghouse Air Brake Co said on Thursday that Scandinavian Incentive Holdings agreed to sell six million Westinghouse Air shares to an investment group led by Vestar Capital Partners and four million shares directly back to Westinghouse Air.
Scandinavian's shares will be sold for $11 apiece. Westinghouse was trading Thursday morning at 12-3/4, up slightly from its Wednesday close of 12-5/8.
Westinghouse Air Brake was purchased in 1990 by a group that included Cardo, a Swedish company later acquired by Scandinavian Incentive.
This sale, if approved by creditors, would divest Scandinavian of its entire Westinghouse Air stake.
